content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm experiencing an issue after downloading a program from a [product_name] controller at a customer site. The customer requested some updates to the logic, but when I open the program, I notice that adding new logic gates is not possible—they appear disabled, and only Constants can be added. Basic/Special Functions are unavailable. Could this be due to a software setting? I've attached a screenshot for reference. Any advice would be appreciated!
Could you please share the actual program file? The screenshot by itself isn't enough to diagnose the issue.
Hi, check which [product_name] series is selected in [product_name] software. You can verify or change this selection via the menu or using the icon on the bottom right.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to modify a downloaded program from a [product_name] controller in [product_name] software, as essential logic functions are disabled for editing. This restriction impacts workflow, especially when updates are required post-download. Other forum members point out that software settings, such as series selection, might be causing the confusion, highlighting possible usability concerns with implicit or unclear options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to freely modify all logic components within a downloaded program and anticipates a smooth, easily accessible editing process in the software interface.
